_about: Philis sidecar: every rule, layer, device and PEX value comes from the GPurify deck named here; this file holds only what the checker does not read (layer roles, generator dimensions, process coefficients).

cell.cap_density_ff_um2_source: UNVERIFIED: no source was recorded with this value.
cell.erc_rules_note: unconnected_conductor listed base layer 'activ', which is not a conductor (connectivity uses derived activ_active = activ NOT gatpoly), so every activ polygon read as on no net (4 false ERC per MOS pair). Now activ_active, matching connectivity.conductors.
cell.avt_n_mv_um_source: sg13_lv_nmos Monte Carlo of the installed models: benchmarks/characterize_mismatch.py ihp_sg13g2 250 1|2, ngspice-44.2, '.lib cornerMOSlv.lib mos_tt_mismatch' with mm_ok=1, PSP103 OSDI compiled by openvaf-r from the repo's verilog-a/psp103/psp103.va (~/pdks/IHP-Open-PDK (git 5e6d592e)); 250 pairs x 6 W/L (1/0.13..8/2 um), diode-connected, constant-current VT at 0.1uA*W/L, sigma(dVT) fit through origin vs 1/sqrt(WL); seeds 1,2 gave 5.1, 5.33 -> 5.2. Model card sg13g2_moslv_mismatch.lib: delvto_mm 3.9 mV.um per device (x sqrt2 = 5.5 per pair). The process spec (libs.doc SG13G2_os_process_spec.pdf) gives no MOS A_VT.
cell.avt_p_mv_um_source: sg13_lv_pmos, same run: seeds 1,2 gave 2.90, 2.99 -> 2.9. Model card delvto_mm 2.2 mV.um per device (x sqrt2 = 3.1).
cell.vt_tc_uv_per_k_source: sg13_lv_nmos benchmarks/characterize_mismatch.py tc ihp_sg13g2, ngspice-44.2, '.lib cornerMOSlv.lib mos_tt' (~/pdks/IHP-Open-PDK (git 5e6d592e)), diode-connected, constant-current VT at 0.1uA*W/L, temp 0/27/85/125 C, least-squares slope: 2/0.5 um -873, 4/1 um -878 uV/K -> 875 (magnitude; VT falls with T). The library reads this single key; pfet in vt_tc_uv_per_k_p.
cell.vt_tc_uv_per_k_p_source: sg13_lv_pmos, same run: 2/0.5 um -762, 4/1 um -751 uV/K -> 757. Not read by the library yet.
cell.svt_uv_per_um_source: PROXY, not ihp_sg13g2 data: Schaper & Linnenbank, 'Comparison of distance mismatch and pair matching of CMOS devices' (Infineon 130 nm, IEEE), Table 1, thin-oxide nMOS S_D [mV/mm = uV/um]: L/W 0.12/1.6 1.63, 0.24/1.6 0.780, 0.24/12.8 0.941, 0.48/1.6 0.582, 0.48/3.2 0.644; S_D grows as L shrinks (Fig. 8, S_D^2 ~ 1/Leff^2). IHP lv Lmin 0.13 um >= 0.12 row: took 1.63, an upper bound at 0.13 um. Same node as the source process.
cell.antenna_source: antenna_gatpoly (Ant.a, 200) added from SG13G2_os_layout_rules.pdf sec. 7.1 (~/pdks/IHP-Open-PDK (git 5e6d592e) libs.doc); existing Ant.b 200, Ant.c 20, Ant.d 20 rules agree with that table (areal ratios). Diode-protected Ant.e/Ant.f not encoded. Ant.a counts GatPoly over field oxide only; the rule here takes all gatpoly, which is stricter.
cell.em_current_density_source: existing em_* rules checked against SG13G2_os_process_spec.pdf (~/pdks/IHP-Open-PDK (git 5e6d592e)) JMAX table: M1 1, M2-M5 2, TM1 15, TM2 16 mA/um; Cont 0.3, Via1-4 0.4, TopVia1 1.4, TopVia2 10 mA/cut: all agree. Narrow-line IMAX (M1 0.36 mA for w 0.16-0.36 um, M2-M5 0.6 mA for w 0.2-0.3 um) not encoded.

resistors.note: GPurify ihp_sg13g2.deck: rsil_body = ((gatpoly and polyres) and res) not psd not salblock, enclosed by extblock 180 (Rsil.e); rppd_body = ((gatpoly and polyres) and psd and salblock) not nsd; res_mk = polyres or res cuts gatpoly_c.

waivers.multiple_drivers: Analog: a node driven by two drains (a differential pair's output and its load, a mirror's input) is the circuit, not a fault. The rule counts distinct gate nets driving a net (a digital fan-in check).
